name: Minnal Murali
summary: Kerala's lightning-struck tailor: Jaison from the village of Kurukkanmoola, who gains powers on Christmas Eve and becomes its protector. Tovino Thomas in the 2021 Malayalam film.
origin: In the 1990s, Jaison is a young tailor who dreams of moving to the US. On Christmas Eve he is struck by lightning at the same moment as Shibu, a lonely outsider, and both gain superpowers. After learning that his real father was Martin, a theatre actor who has died, Jaison disguises himself as Minnal Murali (Lightning Murali), a character from Martin's unfinished play. Shibu frames that masked figure for a deadly fire, so Jaison has to clear his name, win over the village, and finally stop Shibu himself.
powers: Telekinetic abilities from a Christmas Eve lightning strike
Grit found by remembering his father's sacrifice

gossip.text: COVID-19 closed cinemas, so the film premiered at the Mumbai Film Festival on 16 December and on Netflix on Christmas Eve, 24 December 2021.
The hero and the villain get their powers from the same lightning strike.
The concept poster was unveiled on 21 January 2019, Tovino Thomas's birthday.
Filming was interrupted by both waves of the pandemic and finished in July 2021.
Amar Chitra Katha launched a graphic novel, Minnal Murali Strikes Again, at Comic Con India 2024.
Minnal Murali is Jaison's real name.

theme.tagline: One Christmas Eve bolt, one very surprised village tailor.

timeline.title: Lightning strikes Kurukkanmoola
timeline.note: Tovino Thomas's village tailor gets superpowers from a lightning bolt. The film premieres at MAMI, then on Netflix on 24 December.

timeline.title: A global Netflix hit
timeline.note: It streams worldwide with five dubs and breaks into Netflix's global top 10 for non-English films.

timeline.title: Kerala State awards
timeline.note: The film picks up four Kerala State Film Awards, Best Visual Effects among them.

timeline.title: Asian Academy win
timeline.note: Basil Joseph is named Best Director (Fiction) at the Asian Academy Creative Awards in Singapore.

timeline.title: Minnal Murali Strikes Again
timeline.note: Amar Chitra Katha launches a graphic novel at Comic Con India that carries his story past the film.

facts.text: Director Basil Joseph says the film drew inspiration from the 1984 Malayalam fantasy My Dear Kuttichathan.
Tovino Thomas says real accounts of lightning survivors, such as watches stopping or bulbs glowing, were used to ground the film's superpowers.
The title means Lightning Murali. Minnal Murali is a character from the unfinished play of Jaison's late father, Martin, and Jaison borrows the name as his disguise.
Jaison and the teashop worker Shibu are hit by the same Christmas Eve bolt and both gain telekinetic powers, so the hero and the villain share one origin.
When Shibu and Jaison clash on a bus, the driver dies and the bus ends up hanging over a cliff. Jaison saves it, and that wins the villagers' respect.
A temporary church set near Kalady, costing roughly ₹5 million, was vandalised in May 2020 and six men were arrested. Filming moved to Karnataka, where Hemavati Reservoir hosted most of the climax.

Netflix released it worldwide in Malayalam with dubs in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Hindi and English. It became only the third Indian film on its global non-English Top 10, with 5.9 million viewing hours reported at launch.
Kerala Police made a parody video about the superhero to promote traffic safety and crime awareness.
Amar Chitra Katha, best known for mythology, launched the graphic novel Minnal Murali Strikes Again at Comic Con India 2024.
Promotion teamed the film with wrestler The Great Khali and cricketer Yuvraj Singh, put a comic strip in Malayala Manorama, flashed a logo montage on Ain Dubai and released a Twitter emoji.
Shibu burns Jaison's shop while posing as Minnal Murali, so the cast list names him a fake Minnal Murali, and the hero must clear the name he borrowed.
Tovino Thomas plays a dual role: Jaison, and also Martin, the theatre artist who is Jaison's biological father and whose unfinished play gives the hero his name.

Hindustan Times said the film had finally cracked the superhero formula for India. The New Indian Express called it the best superhero film made in India and praised how it makes viewers care about the villain as much as the hero.

Netflix first planned to stream it 45 days after a cinema run. Repeated pandemic closures of theatres and rising costs from delay led producer Sophia Paul to pick direct streaming, confirmed in September 2021.
The story is set in the 1990s in Kurukkanmoola, where Jaison the tailor dreams of building a career in the US until a family secret and a lightning bolt change his plans.
'Bruce Lee' Biji is played by Femina George, cast after Aju Varghese shared an open call for a lead actress aged 20 to 28. Biji later helps Jaison try to prove his innocence.
The villain Shibu is driven by love for his childhood sweetheart Usha, who resents him. He first uses his powers to protect her from harassment at a teashop, and his obsession grows from there.
In a 2022 interview Tovino Thomas said a sequel is being planned but will happen in due course, so the hero's story may not be over.
Shooting stopped in April 2021 when Tovino Thomas tested positive for COVID-19, then wrapped on 25 July 2021, with producer Sophia Paul confirming it in an Instagram post.
Basil Joseph worked closely with the VFX team during scripting, planning storyboards and checking what was possible before shooting began.
Priyanka Chopra, who chaired the Mumbai Film Festival, announced the film's world premiere there, ahead of its Netflix release on Christmas Eve 2021.

kidSummary: Minnal Murali is a Malayalam superhero film about Jaison, a village tailor who gains telekinetic powers when lightning strikes him on Christmas Eve. Shibu, a lonely man hit by the same bolt, becomes the villain. It has fights, fires and sad moments, so it is best for older kids.
